problem.title: Search Suggestions System
problem.statement:
You are given an array of strings products and a string searchWord.

Design a system that suggests at most three product names from products after each character of searchWord is typed. Suggested products should have a common prefix with searchWord. If there are more than three products with a common prefix, return the three lexicographically minimum products.

Return a list of lists of the suggested products after each character of searchWord is typed. The result contains one list per character of searchWord (in order), and each list contains at most three product names in lexicographic order.

**Input:**
The first line contains an integer n, the number of products.
The next n lines each contain one product string.
The next line contains the string searchWord.

**Output:**
Print exactly len(searchWord) lines. The i-th line (1-indexed) contains the suggested products after typing the first i characters of searchWord, as space-separated strings in lexicographic order (at most three). If no products match, print an empty line.

**Constraints:**
1 <= products.length <= 1000
1 <= products[i].length <= 3000
1 <= sum(products[i].length) <= 2 * 10^4
All the strings of products are unique.
products[i] consists of lowercase English letters.
1 <= searchWord.length <= 1000
searchWord consists of lowercase English letters.

**Examples:**
Example 1:
Input:
5
mobile
mouse
moneypot
monitor
mousepad
mouse
Output:
mobile moneypot monitor
mobile moneypot monitor
mouse mousepad
mouse mousepad
mouse mousepad

Example 2:
Input:
1
havana
havana
Output:
havana
havana
havana
havana
havana
havana
